tenderAddress.blockNumber: The Chamber of Registrar, City Civil Court, Ground Floor, City Civil Court Complex, Next to Kaveri Bhavan, Ambedkar Veedhi, Bengaluru-09 Location details on Google Maps XHFM plus 7F7 Bengaluru, Karnataka, or XHFM plus 6C Bengaluru, Karnataka 12.9731536, 77.5836655. Issuing of Certificate of attendance will be done only till 1.30 pm., or till the conclusion of the meeting to the participants only. Further, if the number of participants is less and chances of success of the tender because of minimum of participants seems lesser then the certificate may be issued to more participants who appear before the undersigned authority even after the conclusion of the meeting, regardless of any condition specified whatsoever.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
